features.summary: Offer only currently registered root panels and navigate using their current display labels.

A target removed before selection reports a stale-target error.

features.title: Navigate to a recent session
features.summary: Offer at most twenty newest sessions after excluding blank, subagent, and archived sessions, then open the selected session after the palette closes.
failureModes: A stale session row reports an error and leaves current navigation unchanged.

features.title: Expose thread-sidebar actions when supported
features.summary: Register palette and search entries only when thread-sidebar acknowledges its cancelable capability probe.
failureModes: Missing or rejected capability acknowledgement omits the dependent action.
